pack-1.tagline: Catchy, colorful and impossible to forget.
pack-1.description: From emotional ballads and electro-pop bangers to summer anthems and radio-ready hits, this pack is packed with huge hooks, uplifting melodies and feel-good energy. Perfect for creators, brands and anyone looking for music that instantly connects.

pack-2.tagline: Built for bars, beats and big ambition.
pack-2.description: Dive into modern trap, melodic rap, conscious storytelling, desi hip-hop, drill-inspired energy and hard-hitting street anthems. Expect deep 808s, powerful flows, cinematic production and tracks that command attention from the first beat.

pack-3.tagline: Late nights, smooth vibes and soul in every note.
pack-3.description: A collection of silky melodies, emotional grooves, atmospheric textures and soulful instrumentals. From romantic slow burns to modern urban vibes, every track feels like a midnight drive through city lights.

pack-4.tagline: Turn it up and let the guitars speak.
pack-4.description: Featuring melodic rock, alternative rock, cinematic rock soundtracks and arena-ready anthems. Powerful riffs, emotional energy and unforgettable melodies built for adventure, rebellion and pure freedom.

pack-5.tagline: Feel the rhythm. Live the fuego.
pack-5.description: From reggaeton and Latin trap to bachata, salsa and tropical pop, this pack brings sunshine, passion and movement to every track. Expect infectious grooves, romantic melodies, dancefloor energy and vibrant sounds inspired by Latin culture.

pack-6.description: Featuring modern country anthems, emotional ballads, outlaw country, folk-country and road-trip soundtracks. Acoustic guitars, heartfelt storytelling and small-town soul come together in a collection built on authenticity.

pack-7.tagline: Built for the drop. Made for the crowd.
pack-7.description: Festival anthems, euphoric melodies, massive drops and hands-in-the-air moments. From commercial EDM to cinematic dancefloor bangers, every track is designed to move people.

pack-8.description: A colorful mix of polished pop production, emotional ballads, dance anthems, Korean R&B, hip-hop influences and festival-ready energy. Packed with catchy melodies, huge choruses and modern Seoul-inspired sound.

pack-9.description: Relaxed island grooves, roots reggae rhythms, dub influences and soulful Caribbean energy. From beach sunsets and tropical escapes to feel-good summer moments, this pack is all about positive vibrations.

pack-10.description: A playful blend of swing brass, jazz grooves, electro beats and dancefloor energy. Expect classy melodies, roaring horns and enough groove to light up any party.

pack-11.description: Deep 808s, hard-hitting drums, cinematic atmospheres and modern street energy. From emotional melodic trap to aggressive festival-ready bangers, this pack hits hard every time.

pack-12.tagline: For the nights that change everything.
pack-12.description: A collection of emotional guitars, raw energy and beautifully imperfect storytelling. Expect everything from cinematic alternative rock and moody indie-inspired anthems to dark atmospheric rock journeys, heartbreak ballads and rebellious coming-of-age soundtracks. Music for the dreamers, outsiders and late-night thinkers.

pack-13.description: Bright melodies, warm guitars, nostalgic synths and feel-good energy wrapped into songs that feel like memories. From carefree summer road trips and city adventures to emotional late-night reflections, this pack captures the magic hidden in everyday moments.

pack-14.description: Bright guitars, uplifting melodies, coming-of-age vibes and feel-good hooks. Inspired by road trips, summer nights, teenage memories and endless possibilities, this pack delivers pure feel-good momentum.

pack-15.tagline: Feel-good grooves that never stop moving.
pack-15.description: Warm basslines, infectious rhythms and uplifting energy built for sunsets, rooftops, beach parties and dancefloors. House music in its happiest form.

pack-16.description: Dark, hypnotic and relentlessly addictive. Featuring underground warehouse energy, driving basslines, futuristic sound design and immersive late-night vibes.

pack-17.description: Crushing riffs, thunderous drums, epic breakdowns and cinematic intensity. From dark emotional journeys to battle-ready soundtracks, this pack delivers maximum impact for creators who want serious energy.

pack-19.tagline: Stories carried by strings and soul.
pack-19.description: Timeless acoustic melodies, heartfelt storytelling and organic instruments that feel like they belong around a campfire. Featuring modern folk, cinematic folk, acoustic journeys and rustic soundscapes inspired by open roads, wild landscapes and human connection.

pack-20.tagline: Every note comes from the heart.
pack-20.description: Rich vocals, emotional grooves and timeless melodies designed to make you feel something. From modern soul and neo-soul inspired sounds to uplifting feel-good grooves and intimate emotional moments, this pack is all about authenticity and emotion.

pack-21.description: Powerful harmonies, uplifting melodies and inspiring musical journeys rooted in hope, faith and resilience. Featuring soulful choirs, emotional piano, orchestral warmth and the kind of music that fills every room with positivity and purpose.

pack-22.tagline: Smooth enough to relax. Deep enough to stay with you.
pack-22.description: A sophisticated collection of lounge grooves, smoky late-night melodies, jazz fusion, cafe atmospheres and timeless improvisation. From mellow piano bars and city-night soundtracks to modern jazz-inspired fusion, every track carries effortless style.

pack-23.description: From delicate piano pieces and intimate chamber ensembles to grand symphonies and cinematic orchestral masterpieces, this collection celebrates the beauty of melody, harmony and human expression. Featuring elegant strings, soaring orchestras, emotional piano works and centuries of musical inspiration, these are the sounds that never go out of style.

pack-24.description: A boundary-pushing collection where Bollywood emotion collides with electronic energy. Explore Hindi Tech House, Afro House, Techno, Trance, Phonk, Synthwave, Drum & Bass, Future Bass, Amapiano and more - all infused with sitar melodies, tabla grooves, bansuri textures and unmistakable Indian soul. Built for creators who want something familiar, yet completely new.

pack-25.tagline: Every love story deserves a melody.
pack-25.description: From modern Bollywood ballads and dreamy desi pop to soulful Sufi-inspired romance and cinematic love themes. Expect emotional melodies, heartfelt vocals, warm acoustic textures, beautiful Indian instrumentation and the kind of songs that feel like they belong in your favorite love story.

pack-26.description: A powerful blend of alternative rock, cinematic rock, Punjabi folk-rock, Bollywood rock and modern desi guitar-driven anthems. From emotional heartbreak ballads to rebellious rock journeys, this pack delivers massive riffs, raw emotion and unforgettable melodies infused with Indian character.

pack-29.description: Raw desi energy meets modern hip-hop production. Featuring Mumbai street rap, Punjabi trap, Bollywood-inspired hip-hop, desi drill, Sufi rap and South Indian trap influences. Expect heavy 808s, dhol grooves, sitar samples, aggressive flows and tracks built for ambition, hustle and self-expression.

pack-30.description: One of the most diverse collections in the library. Discover Indian music fused with Lo-Fi, Jazz, Ambient, Techno, House, Reggae, Celtic, Afro House, Drum & Bass, Dubstep, Phonk and countless other genres. Every track takes familiar Indian sounds and places them in completely unexpected worlds.

pack-33.tagline: Built for legends, kings and destiny.
pack-33.description: Inspired by Bollywood blockbusters, ancient kingdoms, mythological stories and cinematic adventures. Massive orchestras, choirs, dhols, tablas, sitars, sarangis, bansuri flutes and heroic melodies come together to create larger-than-life soundtracks worthy of gods, warriors and empires.

pack-34.description: Explore J-pop anthems, city pop nostalgia, Japanese rock, emotional ballads and modern Tokyo-inspired sounds. A collection bursting with catchy hooks, uplifting energy and unforgettable melodies.

pack-35.description: Epic battle themes, emotional piano pieces, fantasy journeys, cyberpunk atmospheres, heroic anime openings and cinematic orchestral scores. Music that feels like stepping into your favorite anime world.

pack-36.description: From emotional Mandopop ballads and Chinese hip-hop to orchestral scores and traditional fusion. Featuring guzheng, erhu and modern production, this pack blends ancient culture with contemporary sound.

pack-37.description: Warm guitars, organic instruments and heartfelt melodies designed to tell stories without saying a word. Perfect for emotional moments, travel content, weddings, documentaries and intimate storytelling.

pack-38.description: A diverse collection of Polish pop, hip-hop, rock, folk fusion, EDM and cinematic sounds. Emotional melodies, powerful storytelling and contemporary European production create a uniquely Polish experience.

pack-39.description: Featuring Baile Funk, Brazilian trap, phonk fusion, carnival rhythms and explosive club energy. Fast, loud and impossible to ignore - music made for movement, confidence and celebration.

pack-40.description: Dusty textures, mellow beats, nostalgic melodies and endless late-night vibes. Perfect for studying, relaxing, creating or simply watching the rain fall outside.

pack-41.tagline: Music for places words can't reach.
pack-41.description: Floating soundscapes, atmospheric textures, cinematic emotion and peaceful sonic journeys. Built for meditation, reflection, sleep and pure escapism.

pack-42.description: Soulful guitar licks, smoky grooves and honest storytelling straight from the heart. From slow-burning blues ballads and road-trip anthems to gritty modern blues-rock hybrids, this pack captures the beauty of life's highs, lows and everything in between.

pack-43.description: Massive guitar riffs, aggressive drums, stadium-sized energy and pure adrenaline. Featuring classic hard rock attitude, modern production and high-octane instrumentals built for action, sports and rebellion.

pack-44.description: Rapid breakbeats, rolling basslines and nonstop momentum. From atmospheric journeys to high-octane adrenaline rushes, this pack never slows down.

pack-45.description: Massive drops, aggressive sound design and cinematic energy collide in a collection built for gamers, creators and anyone who loves pure sonic destruction.

pack-46.description: Euphoric melodies, emotional buildups and hypnotic rhythms designed to transport you somewhere beyond the dancefloor. Pure electronic escapism.

pack-47.description: Deep grooves, tribal percussion and uplifting melodies inspired by cultures from around the world. Warm, energetic and impossible not to move to.

pack-48.description: Distorted bass, hypnotic cowbells, underground energy and street-racing attitude. From drift edits to gym sessions, this pack was built for pure adrenaline.

pack-49.tagline: Chaos has never sounded so fun.
pack-49.description: Glitchy synths, explosive energy, futuristic production and boundary-breaking creativity. Bright, unpredictable and impossible to ignore.

pack-50.description: Rolling basslines, hypnotic rhythms and infectious club vibes. Designed for packed dancefloors, rooftop parties and late-night afterhours sessions.

pack-51.tagline: Built for legends, victories and unforgettable plays.
pack-51.description: From anime battles and boss fights to phonk-fueled chaos and cinematic adventures. High-energy tracks built for gameplay, streams, highlights and epic moments.

pack-52.tagline: Find your calm, one breath at a time.
pack-52.description: Breathe deeper, move slower. Peaceful ambient textures, nature-inspired soundscapes and calming world melodies designed for mindfulness and inner balance.

pack-53.description: The perfect soundtrack for creators. Lo-fi beats, uplifting instrumentals, chill electronic grooves and cinematic textures that elevate your content without overpowering it.

pack-54.tagline: Fuel your grind. Break your limits.
pack-54.description: No limits. No excuses. Hard-hitting phonk, EDM, trap, rock and adrenaline-fueled anthems engineered to keep your energy at maximum.

pack-55.tagline: Set the mood, keep the focus.
pack-55.description: Clean, subtle and conversation-friendly. Warm acoustic tones, soft ambient textures and light grooves that create atmosphere while keeping the focus on your story.

pack-56.description: Every journey deserves a soundtrack. Discover cinematic adventures, tropical vibes, indie road-trip anthems and world-inspired sounds made for exploration.

pack-57.tagline: Music for ideas that move forward.
pack-57.description: Professional doesn't have to sound boring. Modern, uplifting and inspiring music designed for presentations, launches, business content and ambitious ideas.

pack-58.description: Feel-good music for everyday moments. From cafe vibes and tropical grooves to cozy acoustic tracks and stylish lounge sounds.

pack-59.description: Love, celebration and unforgettable memories. Romantic melodies, emotional instrumentals and elegant soundtracks crafted for life's most special moments.

pack-60.tagline: Stay focused. Stay in the zone.
pack-60.description: Focus without distraction. Lo-fi beats, ambient textures and calming instrumentals designed to help you stay productive for hours.

pack-61.description: Slow down and drift away. A laid-back blend of reggae, dub, lo-fi, psychedelic sounds and mellow grooves for the perfect chill session.

pack-62.tagline: Music that feels larger than life.
pack-62.description: Epic worlds, unforgettable stories. From orchestral masterpieces and anime themes to emotional dramas and blockbuster-style cinematic scores.

pack-63.description: For every chapter of romance. Bollywood-inspired melodies, heartfelt acoustic songs, dreamy R&B and emotional soundtracks that speak directly to the heart.

pack-64.description: Lose yourself in the unknown. Psychedelic journeys, hypnotic rhythms, spiritual textures and mind-bending soundscapes built for exploration and imagination.

external-middle-east.description: Arabic pop, traditional fusion, Middle Eastern trap, desert house and cinematic instrumental journeys. Expect oud, qanun, ney flute, darbuka percussion and rich cultural sounds blended with modern production.
